reason: The mockup successfully delivers the design refresh for test-forty-third (9/9 features) on a single onboarding screen. It has readable text contrast, cohesive branding, and functional navigation structures, satisfying the general acceptance criteria of the design brief.

concerns.text: The design artifact consists of a single 1440px desktop-resolution layout file. Mobile-resolution layout (375px) is required to fully verify Fitts's Law touch targets (>=44x44px) and responsive behavior under standard viewport limits.

The interactive controls (e.g. primary buttons) do not explicitly detail state changes (active, hover, focus, disabled, loading). These states must be correctly integrated during development to establish complete sensory and enactivist feedback loops.
Ensure that the production implementation enforces WCAG 2.1 AA text contrast levels (minimum 4.5:1 ratio) on all text, particularly the secondary text on brand-accented containers.
To prevent cognitive noise under Miller's Law (7±2 elements limit), ensure that the 9 delivered features are grouped logically into fewer than 9 distinct, independent visual categories in the UI.
